newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN OIL DEREGULATION SEEN THIS YEAR.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN OIL DEREGULATION SEEN THIS YEAR.

text.p: A task team will be appointed soon to review the South African liquid fuels industry, with deregulation expected to completed by the end of the year, Deputy Minerals and Energy Affairs Minister Susan Shabangu said on Monday.
"Some call it deregulation, some call it reregulation -- what ever that means -- but the intention is to do it by the end of this year," she told reporters at the start of the parliamentary session.

The heavily controlled oil industry has been campaigning for some time for the various controls on it to be lifted but government has been hesistant to act too quickly as this could affect jobs and fuel prices.
Cabinet is still considering the application by the oil industry for a three cents a litre increase in its marketing margin.
